recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century music album cover featuring a centered portrait of a smiling man in a suit against a vibrant, solid red background, framed by a thin white rounded-corner border. The top third is dominated by bold, stacked, high-contrast typography in white and pale yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy top third balanced by a centered subject in the bottom two-thirds
High-contrast white and yellow text against a saturated red field
Thin white framing line containing all primary visual elements
Subject's dark suit providing a visual anchor against the bright background
coreInvariants: Thin white line border with rounded corners
Three-tier typographic hierarchy at the top
Smiling male subject in formal attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered in the lower half, medium-close shot showing head and shoulders with hands clasped.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, pale yellow secondary title text acts as the primary horizontal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white title, moves to the yellow artist name, scans the tracklist block, and settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample red space surrounding the subject and between the border and the edge of the canvas.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white for primary title and framing border
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale cream-yellow for the secondary artist name
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high-value (light) text for maximum legibility.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif and heavy grotesque sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Thick, uniform stroke weights for the sans-serif
Sharp, bracketed serifs for the display face
characterSpecificRedesigns: Condensed 'O' and 'R' to fit tight horizontal constraints
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a serif display face with a blocky, ultra-bold sans-serif for impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slab serif display style of the top line.
Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy sans-serif of the second line.
Suitable for the smaller tracklist text block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid tomato-red square canvas. In the center, a studio portrait of a middle-aged man with short brown hair, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and patterned tie, smiling warmly with hands clasped. Surround the entire composition with a thin white line border that has rounded corners, leaving a small margin of red outside the line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of centered text at the top. Top line: Large, bold, white condensed slab-serif. Middle line: Large, ultra-bold, pale yellow condensed sans-serif. Bottom block: Smaller, white condensed sans-serif text arranged in three tight lines with bullet points.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, vibrant red?
Is the white border line present and rounded at the corners?
Are there three distinct levels of text hierarchy at the top?
Is the subject centered and smiling?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is clearly legible against the red.
Ensure the white border does not touch the edge of the frame.
Verify the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Confirm the subject's expression is friendly and approachable.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color background + Thin rounded border + Stacked condensed display type + Centered studio portrait.
